ARKNIGHTS_CHERNOBOG_EVENT_SUPPLY_CACHE.p:
At the end of a snowed-in alley lies a pile of supply crates abandoned by [orange]Reunion[/orange]. A few have already been pried open; the rations and ammunition left inside are frozen solid.

The [gold]steel chest[/gold] at the back is still padlocked, its frost untouched.

Somewhere in the dark, something is [jitter]panting[/jitter].
Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] Attack cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Fight [red]Guerrilla Hounds[/red]. Gain an extra [blue]75[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] if you win.
Rock-hard tins and ration bars. You wash down a meal that refuses to warm up with snowmelt, but you [green]feel stronger[/green].
Tucked between the magazines is a notebook full of scrawled [gold]tactical notes[/gold]. Messy, but useful.
ARKNIGHTS_CHERNOBOG_EVENT_GUERRILLA_CAMP:
A few broken walls hold back the snow, and a small [orange]campfire[/orange] crackles between them. Around it sit several guerrilla veterans in heavy cloaks, a battered [gold]tower shield[/gold] propped against the wall.

They glance at you and leave their blades sheathed. One of them feeds a plank to the fire and nods for you to sit.

You share what you brought. The soup in the pot is thin, but everyone gets a bowl.

The veterans talk about marching across the tundra, when their commander always ate [gold]last[/gold].

A veteran recounts a holding action on the snowfield: how the shield wall stopped the gunfire, how to hold one more round before the line breaks.

You quietly take note of the [gold]tricks[/gold].
You leave them be and skirt around the firelight. Behind you, a low [sine]song[/sine] begins.
ARKNIGHTS_CHERNOBOG_EVENT_ORIGINIUM_VEIN:
The wall of the conduit tunnel has split open. A cluster of black [orange]Originium crystals[/orange] juts out between the steel plates, [orange][sine]amber light[/sine][/orange] seeping through the cracks.

A pickaxe lies on the ground, the cloth on its handle gone black. You know what touching it bare-handed means.
Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Rare[/gold] cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add an [red]Oripathy[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].

The crystal is warm in your palm. After a [jitter]sting[/jitter], something that is not yours settles in your mind.

On the back of your hand, a tiny black [red]crystal[/red] quietly breaks the skin.
You wrap your hands in cloth and chip the shards loose one swing at a time. The splinters cut your arms, but these crystals are [gold]worth a fortune[/gold] on the black market.
You back away and give the crystals a wide berth. Some things are best never touched.
ARKNIGHTS_CHERNOBOG_EVENT_CORE_VALVE.pag:
Deep in the engine hold, a huge [gold]valve wheel[/gold] sits where the pipes converge, [sine]steam[/sine] hissing from every seam. The [red]warning lamp[/red] above keeps flashing; the pressure gauge pinned itself long ago.

The mobile city is still moving, and its heart is about to give out.
Lose [red]7[/red] HP. Remove a card from your [gold]Deck[/gold].
Your HP is too low, or you have no card to remove.
Your [gold]Deck[/gold] has too few cards that can be transformed.
You grit your teeth and turn the wheel as scalding steam blasts your face. The pressure finally [green]drops[/green], and you shed some dead weight along with it.
You do the opposite and crank the valve all the way. The pipes [jitter]shudder[/jitter], a flash of white light follows, and your memories are [purple]scrambled[/purple].
You leave it alone. Behind you, the warning lamp keeps blinking.
ARKNIGHTS_CHERNOBOG_EVENT_RHODES_AIRDROP:
A [blue]supply pod[/blue] juts from the snow at an angle, its parachute slumped beside it. The hatch hangs half open, cold white light spilling out.

Overhead, a small drone is flying away. A friendly delivery, it seems. Only two crates remain inside, and you only have time to take one.
Bandages, hemostatics and a [green]field injector[/green]. You patch yourself up and feel much better.
Neatly packed [blue]vials[/blue], each labeled with instructions, and a handwritten note that says "[gold]Take care[/gold]."
ARKNIGHTS_CHERNOBOG_EVENT_BLACK_SNAKE_WH:
In the empty hall, the darkness [purple][sine]writhes slowly[/sine][/purple]. A great black snake lies coiled there, a single eye burning with [red]dim red fire[/red].

"You want power," it says, the voice rising from inside your own head. "I can give it to you. For a small... [jitter]price[/jitter]."
Lose [red]6[/red] Max HP. Obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].
Your Max HP is too low.

Your blood drips to the floor and the darkness [sine]swallows[/sine] it. When you come to, something is in your hand.

The snake's eye narrows, as if smiling.
A heavy pouch of [gold]Gold[/gold] lands at your feet. As you bend to pick it up, your fingertips brush a cold [red]crystal[/red].
You turn to leave. A low laugh follows you from the dark: "[purple]We will meet again.[/purple]"
